name: lead_p2v2c

env.TWX_RUNS: base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s1 base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s2 base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s3 base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s4 ms_c3_base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s3 ms_c3_base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s4 ms_c3_base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied_s5

setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,train_100M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py
note: v2c 10M epoch-sweep completion SOLO (experimenter 08:52Z): e3, e6, e7, e8 s0 from jobs_gpu_p2v2c.json @ ref-0162 (code = ref-0161); each gets score_trial, twin ref-0026 and v2 dump ref-0034 with temps 0.9-1.2. Front: ptv2bf back-fill (PTV2_BF) and eval-only twins (TWX_RUNS), moved here from base_size_m.

jobs.name: ptv2bf
jobs.cmd: gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p babylm/moonshot && touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py && gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; }; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; if [ -n "${PTV2_BF:-}" ]; then for r in $PTV2_BF; do S=babylm/runs/_ptv2_bf/$r; mkdir -p $S && gsutil -m -q rsync -r __BUCKET__/ptv2_in/$r $S && CK= && { [ ! -f $S/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || CK="--check $S/dev_bpw_twin.json"; } && /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out $S/dev_v2.npz $CK > $S/dump.log 2>&1 && echo "[ptv2] bf ok $r" || echo "[ptv2] bf FAILED $r"; rm -rf $S/hf; done; fi

jobs.name: twx
jobs.cmd: for r in ${TWX_RUNS:-}; do S=babylm/runs/_twx/$r; mkdir -p $S/hf && gsutil -m -q rsync -r __BUCKET__/twx_in/$r/hf $S/hf && /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py $S/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out $S/dev_bpw_twin.json > $S/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 && echo "[twx] ok $r" || echo "[twx] FAILED $r"; rm -rf $S/hf; done

jobs.name: v2_S_10M_e3_s0
jobs.cmd: /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_gpu_p2v2c.json --only v2_S_10M_e3_s0; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs v2_S_10M_e3_s0 v2_S_10M_e6_s0 v2_S_10M_e7_s0 v2_S_10M_e8_s0; [ -f babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0 /opt/babylm || echo '[v2] score v2_S_10M_e3_s0 failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] v2_S_10M_e3_s0 failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e3_s0/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] v2_S_10M_e3_s0 failed'; }; exit $rc
